title: Circular ITC-667-2026 - 17032026 - Strict Adherence to the Revised SOP dated 23022026 - Hybrid Hearing
text:
KEY LINES:
C I R C U L A R No. ITC/667/2026 Date:17/03/2026
OPERATING PROCEDURE (CIRCULAR NO. ITC/417/2026, DATED 23/02/2026)
Circular - Strict Adherence to the Revised SOP dated 23/02/2026

FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
C I R C U L A R No. ITC/667/2026 Date:17/03/2026
STRICT COMPLIANCE WITH CLAUSE 3 AND 4 OF THE REVISED STANDARD
OPERATING PROCEDURE (CIRCULAR NO. ITC/417/2026, DATED 23/02/2026)
FOR VIRTUAL / HYBRID HEARING.
In continuation of the Revised Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
issued vide the above-referenced Circular, it has come to the notice of the
High Court that despite clear instructions, some of the Ld. Advocates are not
following the guidelines in its letter and spirit. It is specifically observed that
many Ld. Advocates do not display their names and the mandatory Serial
Number of their case/matter in their virtual profile which results in: (i) the Court
Masters' inability to decipher the identity of the Ld. Advocate/Counsel waiting
in the virtual room, making it difficult to admit the correct Ld.
Advocate/Counsel for the matter on hand; (ii) difficulties and delays faced by
the concerned Ld. Advocates/Counsels themselves in joining the proceedings
as the Court Masters cannot identify them without the requisite prefixes; and
(iii) hampering the smooth transition between matters, affecting the overall
decorum and efficiency of the Hybrid Court proceedings.
Therefore, it is hereby reiterated that:
1. All Ld. Advocates/Counsels must scrupulously follow the display name
format as prescribed in Clause 3 of the SOP (prefixing the Serial
Number followed by the exact name).
2. As per Clause 4, failing to provide a proper display name will result in
the Ld. Advocates/Counsels not being admitted to the Virtual / Hybrid
hearing.
All the Ld. Advocates/Counsels are requested to cooperate and ensure
strict adherence to these instructions so that the Court proceedings can be
conducted smoothly and no inconvenience is caused to any one.
SD/-
REGISTRAR GENERAL
Circular - Strict Adherence to the Revised SOP dated 23/02/2026
